prompt: Photograph a figure in a cramped basement, taken on a Pentax 35mm camera from low down, slightly tilted, with the blurred edge of a filing cabinet in the near foreground. He sits on a metal stool, chest-up, tilting his head as if listening. Over his face is a smooth, slightly yellowed white porcelain oval, set into a tight cream knitted hood; the faceplate has no features at all except a thin black ring painted around its rim and, high inside the ring over one eye, a small red enamel triangle with rounded corners. A hairline crack runs across the porcelain. Black roll-neck, black boiler suit, black rubber gloves. One bare bulb hanging above lights the top of his head and leaves his chest in shadow. Behind him a wall of old monitors, all dark but one, which shows static grey snow. Ilford HP5 pushed, with the red as the only colour. Thanks.
